items.item: A breadcrumb leads back to the contracts list and ends with the contract number, and the header shows the contract number, vendor name, a status badge with text, and at most four key fields (such as value, start and end date)
items.evidence: nav[aria-label=Breadcrumb] 'Contracts / CTR-2024-0187'; header line 'CTR-2024-0187 · Northwind Systems GmbH', 'Active' badge; key figures section has exactly four tiles (Total value, Invoiced/paid, Term, Notice deadline).

items.item: The header has one primary action (such as "Renew contract") and puts other actions such as edit or terminate in a secondary or overflow position
items.evidence: Only 'Manage renewal' is bg-blue-700 filled; 'Download PDF' and 'Request amendment' are outlined secondary buttons. No terminate/edit action exists, and there is no overflow menu.

items.item: Vendor contacts show each person's name and role, with email as a `mailto:` link and phone as a `tel:` link, and the primary contact is marked with text
items.evidence: renderContacts: name, role, href="mailto:..." and href="tel:..." present. But no explicit primary-contact marker: only a note on Katrin Vogel 'Primary for pricing, renewal and amendments.' and a category tag ('Commercial'); other contacts have no primary flag.

items.item: Payment milestones show the due date, amount and status, with amounts right-aligned in tabular figures and formatted as currency, and the milestones are ordered with overdue and due-soon ones first
items.evidence: Table has Due, Amount (text-right, .num tabular-nums, Intl currency USD) and Status badge. But rows are rendered in contract.milestones order (n=1..10, chronological, Paid first); the overdue #7 and due-soon #8 appear after six paid rows. No sort by urgency, only a filter.

items.item: Overdue or upcoming milestones are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 5 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: Status badge text 'Overdue' plus dueNote '16 days late' in renderMilestones; '<14 days' items get 'in N days' (milestone 8 'in 10 days'); the attention banner says 'Milestone 7 overdue by 16 days'.

items.item: The renewal or expiry date is shown as an absolute date with the remaining time stated in words (such as "Expires in 45 days")
items.evidence: Key figure 'Notice deadline' 'Nov 30, 2026' with '25 days left'; banner 'Renewal decision needed by Nov 30, 2026 (25 days)'. Term end Feb 28, 2027 is shown absolute only (no remaining time), but the notice deadline satisfies it.

items.item: Amendments are listed with number, date, a short summary and who approved them, using absolute dates
items.evidence: renderAmendments shows 'Amend. N', fdate (e.g. Oct 28, 2026), type, description. The person shown is 'Raised by Dana Whitfield/Tom Reyes', not an approver; pending amendment 4 has no approver at all.

items.item: Each section has an empty state with a next action (such as "Add contact" or "Add amendment"), a loading state, and an inline error with retry
items.evidence: No loading skeletons or error/retry code anywhere (audit loadingPlaceholders 0). The only empty state is the milestones filter row 'No milestones with this status.' with no action. Contacts, amendments and the other sections have none.

items.item: Terminating the contract asks for confirmation that names the contract and the consequence, with a verb button label and focus not on the destructive button
items.evidence: There is no terminate action or confirmation dialog. The nearest thing is the renewal radio 'Do not renew' and the 'Record decision' button, which saves immediately with no confirm.

notes: Audit score 96 (only uppercase-text x4 on the key-figure labels, which use uppercase tracking-wide). Content and structure are fairly realistic and well built: tabs, attention banners, correct mailto/tel links, tabular currency. Failures are mostly missing states: no loading/error/empty-with-action states, no terminate flow, milestones not sorted by urgency, no explicit primary-contact label, and amendments show 'Raised by' instead of approver. Initials avatar appears on the non-person '24/7 Service desk' contact ('2S'). Status colours (green/red/amber/slate) all carry text labels, so rainbow-status is mild. No gradients, glass, emoji, hover-lift or oversized radius (radii 6-8px). Contacts, milestones, amendments and renewal are hidden behind tabs, so only Terms is visible in the first viewport.
